mapper.insert: insert into xl_star_trade (seller_id, buyer_id, item_type, item_id, stars_amount, status, created_at, completed_at) values (#{sellerId}, #{buyerId}, #{itemType}, #{itemId}, #{starsAmount}, #{status}, now(), #{completedAt})
mapper.select: select id, seller_id, buyer_id, item_type, item_id, stars_amount, status, created_at, completed_at from xl_star_trade where id = #{id}
select id, seller_id, buyer_id, item_type, item_id, stars_amount, status, created_at from xl_star_trade where seller_id = #{sellerId} and status = #{status} order by created_at desc
select item_id from xl_star_trade where seller_id = #{sellerId} and status = '0' and item_type = #{itemType}
select id, seller_id, buyer_id, item_type, item_id, stars_amount, status, created_at from xl_star_trade where status = '0' and item_type = #{itemType} and item_id = #{itemId} limit 1
mapper.update: update xl_star_trade set buyer_id = #{buyerId}, status = '1', completed_at = now() where id = #{id}
update xl_star_trade set status = '2' where id = #{id}
